google_review_notes: Kids app for ages 3-8 (Designed for Families). No login, no accounts, no chat. Every purchase, Restore purchases and the privacy-policy link sit behind a parental gate: tap the lock (top corner of the home screen) and PRESS AND HOLD the correct answer to the multiplication shown (e.g. 7 x 8 = 56) for about 1.5 seconds. Free content: 22 animals in four homes (farm, home, meadow, forest) and the Who says this? game. full_pack unlocks all 44 animals, the six other homes and the Where does it live? game and removes ads; remove_ads removes the banner only. Animal sounds are synthesized by the app (no audio files, no recordings). Ads: AdMob banner only, child-directed (TFCD, TFUA, max rating G), never on game screens; no interstitial or rewarded ads, no notifications, no Play Games, no Firebase.
apple_review_notes: Kids app for ages 3-8. No login. Purchases and links are behind a parental gate: tap the lock on the home screen and press and hold the correct answer to the multiplication shown. Free: 22 animals and the Who says this? game; the one-time All animals & games purchase unlocks 22 more animals, six homes and a second game. Animal sounds are synthesized in the app.
